scene_timeline.visual_description: Drew Simic introduces his challenge of building six startups in six months while sitting in his home office.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Drew says: 'Here we go, I'm building six startups in six months. And honestly, it doesn't matter what will happen. Either these are gonna do well or they're gonna fail.'

scene_timeline.visual_description: Drew explains his current workload, balancing the challenge with his existing business.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Drew says: 'I'm gonna be doing all this while still running a full-time web agency. So, it's gonna be a lot of hours.'

scene_timeline.visual_description: Drew pitches his first software idea, 'Save Drop', explaining the problem of fragmented saved content.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Drew says: 'First software idea of the month: Save Drop. That's a working title. Essentially, you have an Instagram video you have to save, you have a TikTok video, you have a restaurant that your mom sent you off of Google... but not one unified app that connects everything. That's where my solution comes in.'
